speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Fixed Drug Eruption, likely triggered by recent captopril or NSAID use. The history of painful mucosal ulcers and a single site of blistering on the forearm after starting a new medication strongly supports this over Stevens-Johnson syndrome, especially given the lack of systemic involvement and the specific family history of autoimmune conditions. Please continue your prescribed medication while we await the test results to confirm the specific trigger.
